meta.source: Ascentor brand brief (poster layer) and Ascentor App UI Kit brief, supplied by Posi, October 2026; logo SVGs and font files from the ascentor-mvp codebase

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Brand white. The dominant ground (about 60% of a poster), text on rust, black and slate. A brand colour, not empty space.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Headlines, info panels, app body text on white, 2px input and secondary-button borders, the KEPT/done state.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Poster dark ground (black posters, Night-over-White splits). White type, gold accents, white logo.

tokens.name: night-ui
tokens.usage: App dark-mode page background.

tokens.name: frame-ink
tokens.usage: Offset block behind framed speaker photos and featured cards, up and to the left of the gold frame.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Slate (#15181D): a poster background option and the app's dark-mode card surface. White text on slate is 17.8:1.

tokens.name: rust
tokens.usage: Emphasis: highlight bars and primary buttons with white text (5.0:1), dates, stamps, key words, the active tab. On white for text at any size (5.0:1).

tokens.name: rust-light
tokens.usage: Small rust text on dark grounds: 6.0:1 on night-ui, 5.4:1 on slate. Never on white for small text (3.3:1).

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Thin rules, hand-drawn underlines and checks, photo frames, outline icons, THE RISE WE CHOOSE. On white only at display size or as marks (2.4:1); on night 8.2:1.

tokens.name: gold-ink
tokens.usage: Small gold text on white (4.9:1) and on warning-tint (4.5:1).

tokens.name: elevation-gold
tokens.usage: The Ascentor logo only. Never for type, UI or decoration.

tokens.name: horizon-grey
tokens.usage: Small secondary text on white: roles, captions, helper text (4.8:1). Fails on dark grounds (4.1:1 on night-ui): use text-muted there.

tokens.name: dot-grey
tokens.usage: Dot texture on white, card borders and dividers, skeleton blocks, upcoming pathway dots. Decorative only, never text.

tokens.name: occasion-green
tokens.usage: Nigerian green, an occasion accent only (Independence Day and similar). Never a state colour; there is no green in the app.

tokens.name: wine
tokens.usage: PROPOSED. App error text and icon on white (8.1:1). Always with an icon and plain text. Deliberately not rust.

tokens.name: wine-light
tokens.usage: PROPOSED. Error text and icon in dark mode (9.8:1 on night-ui, 8.8:1 on slate).

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: PROPOSED. Warning banner ground (for example the scam-message banner), with gold-ink text and a 1px gold border.

tokens.name: disabled-ground
tokens.usage: PROPOSED. Disabled control fill in light mode. Show the reason nearby.

tokens.name: disabled-ink
tokens.usage: PROPOSED. Disabled control text in light mode (exempt from contrast minimums; never the only way the reason is shown).

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App page background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the tab bar and sidebar. Flat, no shadow.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg and surface (21:1 light, 17.8:1 or more dark).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and captions on bg and surface. Dark value is PROPOSED (7.9:1 on night-ui, 7.1:1 on slate) because horizon-grey fails there.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: 1px card borders and dividers. Decorative, not a control edge. Dark value PROPOSED.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: 2px input, chip and secondary-button borders (control edges, 17:1 or more).

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, active tab, current item, selected state. Text on it is on-action.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons on action and on rust (5.0:1).

tokens.name: action-text
tokens.usage: Small rust text: dates, the active tab label, links in body copy.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, offset 2px. 5.0:1 on white; 6.0:1 on night-ui in dark.

tokens.name: accent-line
tokens.usage: Hand-drawn underlines, thin rules, gold checks, outline icons, featured-card frames. Marks, not text.

tokens.name: gold-text
tokens.usage: Small gold text (labels, mentor roles on dark, warning text): gold-ink on white, gold on dark.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: PROPOSED. Error text, icon and input border. Always paired with an icon and words.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: PROPOSED. Warning banner ground. Dark mode uses slate with the gold border.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: PROPOSED. Warning banner text and icon (4.5:1 on warning-tint; 7.4:1 on slate).

tokens.name: disabled-bg
tokens.usage: PROPOSED. Disabled control fill.

tokens.name: disabled-text
tokens.usage: PROPOSED. Disabled control text.

tokens.name: toast-bg
tokens.usage: Toast fill, with white text. In dark mode it carries a 1px border so it separates from night-ui.

tokens.name: skeleton
tokens.usage: Loading skeleton blocks. Dark value PROPOSED.

styles.name: poster-xl
styles.usage: One to three words that carry a 1080px poster. All caps.

styles.name: poster-lg
styles.usage: Main headline on feed posts and carousel slides. All caps.

styles.name: theme-line
styles.usage: Always gold, two lines, part of the summit lockup.

styles.name: poster-date
styles.usage: Rust on white; rust-light on dark.

styles.name: venue
styles.usage: Heavy black caps in the lockup.

styles.name: label-spaced
styles.usage: Small widely spaced capitals above a headline or inside a rust bar.

styles.name: speaker-name
styles.usage: Name plate on a white panel, black.

styles.name: marker-note
styles.usage: Permanent Marker hand-written note. At most one per design.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: Mobile page title (28–32px). ALL CAPS, one or two lines, gold underline beneath.

styles.name: page-title-desktop
styles.usage: Desktop page title (48–56px). ALL CAPS, gold underline beneath.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Tab names, section tags, chips and input labels. ALL CAPS, never smaller than 12px. Buttons use the same style at 14px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A missed day doesn't reset anything.
styles.usage: All running text. Never below 16px, never all caps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Icon to label, check to text.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Chip gaps, tight groups.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Label to field, list item padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Mobile gutters, minimum card padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Card padding, tablet and desktop gutters, gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Section spacing on mobile.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Section spacing on desktop; poster block gaps.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Tab bar height; poster margins (60–80px on 1080px).

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything: buttons, cards, inputs, chips, bars, frames, sheets.

tokens.name: radius-avatar
tokens.usage: Circular avatars only.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target.

tokens.name: button-height
tokens.usage: Minimum button height.

tokens.name: tabbar-height
tokens.usage: Mobile bottom tab bar.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Desktop left sidebar.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Desktop maximum content width.

tokens.name: icon-size
tokens.usage: Outline icons, one stroke weight.

tokens.name: motion-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press, focus transitions. Eased, no bounce.

tokens.name: motion-base
tokens.usage: Sheets, modals, toasts entering. Eased, no bounce.

tokens.name: toast-hold
tokens.usage: How long a toast stays.
